description: Pull UFC rankings, fighter profiles, event fight cards, and detailed fight results.

dataType.description: What to collect: current rankings, a fighter directory, fighter profiles, event fight cards, or individual fight statistics.
enumTitles: Fighter profiles by ID or name
dataType.title: Data type

eventIds.description: Fetch specific ufcstats.com events instead of scanning the event lists.
eventIds.title: Event IDs or URLs (mode=events)

eventSearch.description: Case-insensitive text match on the event name, e.g. UFC 300 or Fight Night.
eventSearch.title: Event name filter (mode=events)

eventType.description: Completed events, upcoming events, or both.
eventType.title: Event status (mode=events)

fightIds.description: ufcstats.com fight-details IDs or URLs for full per-round statistics.
fightIds.title: Fight IDs or URLs (mode=fights)

fighterIds.description: ufcstats.com fighter IDs or fighter-details URLs, e.g. 032cc3922d871c7f.
fighterIds.title: Fighter IDs or URLs (mode=fighterDetails)

fighterLetter.description: Limit the fighter directory to one last-name initial.
fighterLetter.title: Last-name initial (mode=fighters)

includeFightCards.description: Fetch each event page for its full fight card and results.
includeFightCards.title: Include fight cards (mode=events)

includeFightHistory.description: Add the fighter's UFC fight history to the profile.
includeFightHistory.title: Include fight history (mode=fighterDetails)

includeFightStats.description: Add round-by-round striking and grappling totals to every fight. Costs one extra request per fight.
includeFightStats.title: Include fight statistics (mode=events)

includeFighterBios.description: Add height, weight, reach, stance, age, and record details from the fighter's ESPN profile.
includeFighterBios.title: Include physical stats (mode=rankings)

minWins.description: Drop fighters with fewer recorded wins.
minWins.title: Minimum wins (mode=fighters)

mode.description: Legacy mode values are still accepted and mapped automatically.
mode.title: Legacy mode

searchQuery.description: First name, last name, or nickname. In fighterDetails mode it resolves to fighter profiles; in fighters mode it filters the directory.
searchQuery.title: Fighter name (mode=fighters, fighterDetails)

season.description: Only events from this calendar year (1994–2035).
season.title: Season year (mode=events)

sortFighters.description: Order the directory output. Wins, losses, and bouts sort highest first; name sorts A–Z.
sortFighters.title: Sort fighters by (mode=fighters)

stance.description: Only include fighters with this stance.
stance.title: Stance filter (mode=fighters)

weightClass.description: Division to rank, or every division plus both pound-for-pound lists.
weightClass.title: Weight class (mode=rankings)

title: UFC Stats Scraper Input
